scope: source-bound assigned sender dispatch interlock; software qualification only
fence: shared job and prompt receive/write retirement gate
durable_history: original source line and parsed events queued independently of interlock

initial_full_run.trace_observation: job reached all 80 moves and EOF without Pausing after native wait release
initial_full_run.correction: fixture holds move 11 after native wait until pause submission; no longer races EOF

limitations: One-way authority withdrawal is not a shutdown command or evidence of physical stop
Frames admitted before retirement may have unknown outcomes
No physical readiness/provider, sensor repair, firmware commissioning or restart/reconnect qualification
Negative-temperature classification is specific to room-temperature bench profile
